headline: Emory & Henry top table on three straight wins
dek: Emory & Henry's win at Mars Hill on Tuesday was their third of the season and their third in succession, and it took them above Catawba at the top of the conference table. They are unbeaten with three wins and two draws, eleven scored and four conceded. Catawba and Anderson have not lost either.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-six and conceded four, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Every side in the conference has now won at least once; Lenoir-Rhyne's first came at Newberry on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's win over Lee on Wednesday was their seventh of the season, against two draws and no defeats, and they have scored twenty-six and conceded four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's defeat at home to UAH on Wednesday was their third of the season, against four wins and two draws, with fourteen scored and nine conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tusculum's defeat at Lees-McRae on Wednesday was their fifth of the season, against one win and one draw, and they have scored four goals and conceded twelve.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made thirty-six saves and conceded nine goals.

last_match.line: Catawba remain unbeaten; Lee are the first side to score against them since August.

next_match.line: Mars Hill have not scored since their win at Wingate; Lincoln Memorial arrive off a home win over Montevallo.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
